rule: The text of .env decides the flags agy is run with after `-p <prompt> --output-format <format>`: the permission flags, then --model, then --effort. The effort line is passed on exactly as written (no trimming, no change of case, no list of allowed words); only when it is absent or empty does a thinking line count, and then only the exact word true, read from AGY_THINKING or, when that key is absent, from GEMINI_THINKING. A case with `custom` is a bot set to run a command of the user's own: `args` is then what is added to that command's own arguments. A case with `environment` also sets those variables in the bot's process before it starts; the bot's dotenv never replaces a variable that is already set, so the process wins, even when it is set to nothing. The Mac apps read the file only and never their own process environment, so for those cases they pass `apps` instead of `args`. The bot's own deadline flag (--print-timeout) is not part of this.

cases.name: no effort line and no thinking line: no effort flag
an empty effort line: no effort flag
low
medium
high
capitals are passed on as written: HIGH
a word that is not low, medium or high is passed on as written: max
spaces inside quotes are part of the value and are passed on
spaces outside quotes are removed by dotenv before the bot sees them
GEMINI_EFFORT is not a name the bot reads
AGY_THINKING=true with no effort line means high
AGY_THINKING=true with an empty effort line means high
AGY_THINKING=TRUE is not the word true: no effort flag
AGY_THINKING=1 is not the word true: no effort flag
AGY_THINKING=false: no effort flag
the old name GEMINI_THINKING=true still means high
GEMINI_THINKING=True is not the word true: no effort flag
an empty AGY_THINKING line hides GEMINI_THINKING=true: no effort flag
AGY_THINKING=false wins over GEMINI_THINKING=true: no effort flag
AGY_THINKING=true wins over GEMINI_THINKING=false
an effort line wins over thinking: low
an effort word the bot does not know still wins over thinking: max
the model comes before the effort
a command of the user's own is run as written: no effort flag is added to it
the process says low and the file says high: the bot runs low, the apps run high
the process sets the effort to nothing and the file says high: the bot passes no flag, the apps run high
the process says high and the file has no effort line: the bot runs high, the apps pass no flag
the process says thinking and the file says not: the bot runs high, the apps pass no flag
the process says not thinking and the file says thinking: the bot passes no flag, the apps run high
the old name in the process does not beat the new name in the file
the process says plan and the file says yolo: the bot runs plan, the apps run yolo
the process says yolo and the file says plan: the bot runs yolo, the apps run plan
the process names one model and the file another: the bot runs the process's, the apps the file's
